title: docs(spec): currencyMode says what each mode does; the currency-chain text states the fixed condition
body:
Part of #20126
Clause-②: no

This PR covers the non-governed sites of the currency-mode class-closure card. It does not close the card. The remainder is listed at the end: the Tier H skills site and the enumerating pin.

## What was wrong

`CurrencyConfigSchema` declares two modes. With `currencyMode: 'fixed'`, the field has one currency, `defaultCurrency`. With `dynamic`, the default, the field has no currency of its own and shows the tenant default currency. Every runtime reader follows that rule:

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: the precision refinement judges `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`. The `FieldSchema` guidance says "A field without one uses the tenant default at runtime".
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts` (`sourceFieldMeta`): relays `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`, as landed by the runtime member of this family (#20119).
- objectui's `resolveFieldCurrency`, which the field faces call: reads `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`. Read from objectui's changeset `10422-currency-mode-dynamic-tenant-default.md` at its `main` (`a2f361b`). With no tenant currency set, the amount shows as a plain number.

Four kinds of text still said otherwise:

1. **The spec describe** (card site 1). It called `dynamic` "user selectable". No key, stored value or runtime path offers a per-record currency choice. The value is a bare number (ADR-0104 D1), and the code lives in field config. The describe ships in the published `@objectstack/spec` and in the generated `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx` (2 rows).
2. **`content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`** (card site 3). It named "the ADR-0053 currency chain" with no mode condition. ADR-0053 is the date/datetime record and never mentions currency.
3. **service-analytics test text.** Two test files still called the chain "ADR-0053": the `preview-column-enrichment.test.ts` header table and two `it` titles, and a `query-dataset.test.ts` section comment. The #20119 PR noted the test-file labels and left them as they were.
4. **Hand-written `content/docs/**` lines** that taught `defaultCurrency` without the `fixed` condition. The census is below.

## What changes

- `field.zod.ts`, **`currencyMode` describe only.** It now says what each mode does. `fixed`: the field has one currency, `defaultCurrency`. `dynamic` (the default): no field currency, amounts show in the tenant default (`localization.currency`, or a plain number when that is unset), and `defaultCurrency` is not read. Neither mode is a per-record choice. `gen:docs` regenerated the two `field.mdx` rows. No key, value, default or parse output changes. `.changeset/20126-currency-mode-describe.md` is an `@objectstack/spec` patch.
- **`data-api.mdx`.** The ADR-0053 citation is gone. The callout now states the chain as it runs: measure `currency`, then the source field's `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` only when that field is `currencyMode: 'fixed'`, then the tenant default. It also says where the chain runs. It runs on the dataset query (`POST /analytics/dataset/query`). The cube query this page documents (`POST /analytics/query`) mints no column `currency`, and `currency-mode-relay.test.ts` pins that cube-face fact.
- **service-analytics, comments and test titles only.** The header table row, the two `it` titles, one in-test comment ("no field default" now reads "no fixed field currency") and the `query-dataset.test.ts` section comment now describe the chain with the fixed condition. The old ADR-0053 label is gone. No assertion or runtime line changes.
- **Census fixes** (table below): `validation-rules.mdx`, `common-patterns.mdx` and `protocol/objectql/types.mdx`.

## Census: every hand-written `content/docs` line naming `defaultCurrency` (at base `84880f9`)

Rule, from the card: the line must also carry `fixed`, or say it is not the displayed currency under `dynamic`. The census covers 13 lines, the same per-file counts the dispatch named (3 / 4 / 1 / 2 / 3). `releases/` is never edited.

| file:line | verdict | why |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `data-modeling/field-types.mdx:156` | pass | the mode row states `fixed` and `dynamic` |
| `data-modeling/field-types.mdx:157` | pass | "under `fixed`; not the displayed currency under `dynamic`" |
| `data-modeling/field-types.mdx:160` | pass | the example carries `currencyMode: 'fixed'` |
| `data-modeling/fields.mdx:77` | pass | `currencyMode: 'fixed'` line |
| `data-modeling/fields.mdx:79` | pass | "the column's currency under 'fixed'" |
| `data-modeling/fields.mdx:86` | pass | "not the displayed currency" under `dynamic` |
| `data-modeling/fields.mdx:87` | pass | "`fixed` pins the column to `defaultCurrency`" |
| `data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx:156` | changed | "3-character currency code" with no mode condition. It now adds "the field's currency under `fixed`; not the displayed currency under `dynamic`" |
| `getting-started/common-patterns.mdx:53` | changed | `{ precision: 2, defaultCurrency: 'USD' }` has no mode, so it is `dynamic`, and the budget shows the tenant currency, never USD. Added `currencyMode: 'fixed'` |
| `getting-started/common-patterns.mdx:82` | changed | same, in the map-format tab |
| `protocol/objectql/types.mdx:297` | changed (line shape) | The YAML block already carried `currencyMode: fixed` on :296, but this line did not carry it. Added the comment "the field's currency under fixed" so the line meets the pin |
| `protocol/objectql/types.mdx:308` | changed | "The currency code lives once on the field definition (`currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`)" holds only under `fixed`. It now states both modes |
| `protocol/objectql/types.mdx:315` | pass | carries `fixed` (`currencyMode: fixed \| dynamic`). Left as it was, because the callout above now states the condition |

Two more lines in `validation-rules.mdx` sit in the same `currency` table and belong to the same class, although neither names `defaultCurrency`:

- `:155`, the `currencyMode` row, repeated card site 1's "`dynamic` (user-selectable)" wording. It now matches the describe and adds this page's validation fact: under `fixed`, an authored `precision` must agree with the currency's ISO 4217 fraction digits.
- `:158` said "The per-record currency **code**", which contradicts ADR-0104 D1. It now says the code is never stored per record.

Both sit inside a census-hit file and table, and both are mechanical rewrites in the wording of the accepted #20118 / #20120 pages.

Pin readings after this PR, over the card's own scopes. The census script ran from the scratchpad and was not committed.

- The `defaultCurrency` line rule over `content/docs/**/*.mdx` (without `releases/`): 5 failing at base, **0** at head.
- `ADR-0053` within five lines of `currenc`, over `content/docs/**`, `packages/services/service-analytics/src/**` and `skills/**`: 5 hits at base (`data-api.mdx:467`, `preview-column-enrichment.test.ts:51/:282/:288`, `query-dataset.test.ts:125`) plus the skills site, and **1** at head. The one left is `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:308`, which is the Tier H remainder.

## Tests and gates

All readings below were taken on head `25b085386`. That head is this branch plus a merge of `main` at `e2c4e125f`, and the merge brought nothing into this PR's files. Before the gates ran, all 71 package build tasks passed (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'`, 71/71).

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 109 commands. Each was run and its exit code recorded, and all 109 exit 0. The `--ran` reconciliation answers: "109 derived, 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". The derived set includes `check:docs`, `check:generated` (15 of 15 current), `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt`.
- **Roster gates.** Six roster families keep their roster in a directory this PR touches, and all six exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- **This body.** Run against this text, `check-partof-closing-keyword` exits 0.
- **`@objectstack/spec`.**
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 540 files, 15820 passed, 2 todo.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0.
  - No spec test pins the old describe text. The phrase "user selectable" appears only in the describe and its generated page.
- **`@objectstack/service-analytics`.**
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the two edited files: 2 files, 44 tests passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics run typecheck`: exit 0.
  - `tsc --listFiles` includes both edited test files (2 hits; the control `src/plugin.ts` has 1).
- **Lint, narrowed to the 3 touched TypeScript files** (`pnpm lint` over the whole repo is CI's run):
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` exits 0, and the JSON reports 3 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  - `eslint --print-config` puts the files in the linted population, with 5 rules on.
  - `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so a change to these files cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.
- **No ablation.** The diff changes text only: a describe, docs, comments and test titles. No assertion or runtime line changes, so no negative pin exists to ablate.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `defaultCurrency` describe is left as it was.** It reads "Default or fixed currency code". The claimed surface is the `currencyMode` describe only. The generated row meets the card's pin, because it carries `fixed`, and the rewritten `currencyMode` row beside it now states the condition. "Default" can still read as a dynamic-mode default. That belongs to this family and is noted for the closure card, not changed here.
- **More ADR-0053-for-currency sites exist outside the card's pin scopes.** They are the same family and are not in this PR's claimed surface:
  - `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts:80`: the published TSDoc on `AnalyticsResult.fields[].currency` reads "ADR-0053 currency chain … source-field default → tenant default", with no mode condition. It ships in the `@objectstack/spec` typings.
  - `packages/spec/src/data/percent-scale.ts:14`: a comment saying "mirrors the ADR-0053 currency chain".
  - `packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json` (the `currency` row's evidence text): "the ADR-0053 chain … the source field's `defaultCurrency`".
  - The card's pin scopes (`skills/**`, `content/docs/**`, `service-analytics/src/**`) do not reach `packages/spec/src/**`. These are noted for the closure card.
- **A strictly line-based pin would go red on semantically correct skill lines.** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` lines :55, :183, :184, :191 and :192 were corrected and accepted with #20120. Each states the condition across a wrapped sentence or a two-line comment, but none carries `fixed` on its own line. Whoever writes the enumerating pin must judge a sentence or block, not a single line, or reshape those lines in the same Tier H PR.
- **`data-api.mdx` makes a wider claim than currency.** The callout says `label`, `format` and `percentScale` are resolved server-side on this page's `fields[]`. That is a source read and was not measured. Both cube strategies push only `name` and `type` (`native-sql-strategy.ts:1247/:1252`, `objectql-strategy.ts:1960/:1964`), and the ADR-0021 column enrichment runs only on `queryDataset`. Only the currency sentence was in scope and was corrected. Carrier: none, noted and not filed.
- **Three `query-dataset.test.ts` titles are left as they were.** They say "inherits the field defaultCurrency", "a currency field with no defaultCurrency" and "wins over the field default". They cite no ADR, so they are outside the claimed surface. The section comment above them now says that `sourceFieldMeta().defaultCurrency` is the field's fixed currency.

## Remainder of #20126 (not in this PR)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:304`–`:308`: the unconditioned chain and the ADR-0053 citation. This is Tier H and gets its own PR, per triage execution note 1.
- The enumerating pin: a test in the owning package, added by whichever PR closes the last site (no new `check-*` gate). See the line-based caveat above.
